notes.title: Patch - May 2022
notes.content:
Two small bugs have been reported and fixed in this update.
Bug 1 - constant adding of same journal entry when talking to the kids in the street
Bug 2 - semi-crash when trying to give items to guards in Letize

While neither of these two bugs was serious, we wanted to ensure a smoother experience for you.

notes.title: Patch 1, October 22 2021
notes.content:
A minor bug has been detected and reported by one player. Had no influence on the game itself but we've fixed it to make for a smoother experience.

Bug - during conversation with Kimley, the same journal entry could get added multiple times - FIXED

notes.title: Progress update!
notes.content:
We're working on Trouble Hunter Chronicles and have recently inserted a new NPC into the game. You can see how we test the background animation and interaction in the clip.

[previewyoutube=QfZmDI-tadM;full][/previewyoutube]

Life issues sometimes get in the way and slow down our progress so we're moving the release date to late Spring or possibly Summer. It may not be what you want to hear but creating all the art takes a lot of time.

We'll keep you posted on the exact release date.
